sections.heading: About Sunflower Sprouts
sections.html:
Ages: 16 months–3 years, with adult

Sprouts is a parent/child class like no other! This class introduces children and caregivers to the basics of early cooperative play and problem-solving skills. Creative art exploration, sensory experiences and outdoor play are part of each session. Parents are supported as they develop their own parenting styles and build lasting friendships as they learn and grow together.

Beginning fall 2026, Sunflower Sprouts will meet weekly on:
Mondays, 1:00–2:30 pm OR Saturdays, 9:00–10:30 am
